statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 covering IT and OT
Group CISO accountable; named OT security managers
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up
Risk acceptance authority by level; safety risks treated
Supplements never weaker; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Inheritance documented per division system, including OT
Security review before acquisitions; 180-day integration
Security schedule required for vendors and integrators
OT safe states, manual procedures, and controlled changes
Annual independent assessment including OT
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Retain program records 6 years
AI use cases registered and approved before use or change
Proportionate, documented sanctions
Unique named accounts; shared accounts only for approved HMI shift accounts
Accounts driven by HR events, including non-federated systems
MFA for remote, privileged, and Restricted access
Privileged access through PAM with recording
Removal within 4 hours; seasonal access ends with the season
Quarterly access certification including OT and the FMIS
Vendor remote access only through PAM, on approval, no always-on tools
No default credentials on any device
Documented OT exceptions with compensating controls
Tested break-glass accounts
MFA required for portal and customer administrators
OT reachable only through approved paths
Report to the SOC within 1 hour, including OT anomalies
One group severity scale
Safe state and manual control before anything else
Multi-regulator matrix kept current and exercised yearly
regulatory_driver: N42-R07 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); state breach laws; N11-R01 context (21 CFR 1.361)

statement_summary: Record clock start times; plan to the shortest clock
Disclosure committee within 24 hours of Severity 1
Ransom decisions at board level with an OFAC check
Food safety leads informed at declaration
Preserve IT and OT evidence before rebuild
Lessons learned within 14 days, documented within 30
Four classification levels
Restricted data only in approved systems, encrypted
Quarterly data map review and purge
Food defense plans and OT designs on need-to-know
Regulated retention periods with group-held copies
Regulated records locked after sign-off; edits versioned
Grower data used only as the terms allow
Sanitize all media and OT devices
No sensitive data in unapproved AI tools
Never share accounts or PINs
Report suspicious events and unexpected equipment behavior
No personal devices or USB media on OT
Only approved changes to OT settings
Training at hire and each season, English or Spanish
No worker surveillance through drone or telematics data
Approved AI tools only; check AI outputs
